name: timisoara-time-capsule
description: Holographic Living Museum — 3-screen phygital installation (MuseumsQuartier track, Timișoara).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server start
